tagline.en_US: Self-hosted strength-training tracker with workout logs, programs, progress photos, and a mobile PWA.

description.en_US: LiftTrace is a self-hosted weightlifting and strength-training tracker. It allows users to log workouts, track weights, reps, and RPE, run multi-week training programs, and monitor personal records and body statistics. The platform includes comprehensive exercise libraries, progress photos, and offline support for recording sessions in gyms without network connectivity.
